defects: Conclusion is phrased as `Set.Finite {g : G | orderOf g ≠ 0}` (the set of finite-order elements) rather than `Finite (torsion G)` (finiteness of the torsion subgroup as a type/subgroup). These are mathematically equivalent (torsion G's carrier is exactly {g | orderOf g ≠ 0}, and Set.Finite of a set is equivalent to Finite of its coercion), but it is a different structural formalization rather than a mere notational variant of the gold's Subgroup-based conclusion.
